title: Lost Page 6: The Cold
summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

goals.say: You stand where the first champion stood. It feels colder than it should.

quest_book.title: Warden Journal, Page 6
quest_book.author: The First Champion
pages: I sheltered here with the second champion. He was younger than I was.
He asked me if it was worth it. I lied.
